officialText:
Prior to the issuance of any permit for work that includes full or partial demolition, submittal documents shall be required in accordance with chapter 33 of the New York city building code.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
